answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The meadow multiplier is published, charged in ripple, and vault lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 15 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 1300 identities would post 2014 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
